verification.notes: Owner-delegated automated documentary comparison, reconciled with a separate automated reviewer. Source acceptance, technical evidence and activation authority are separate. This is not human listening or a signed clinical review.

comparison.expectedText: How is your breathing today — fine, short of breath with activity, or short of breath even at rest?
comparison.recognizedText: How is your breathing today? Fine, short of breath with activity, or short of breath even at rest?
comparison.reconciliation: Source and recognized text retain the intended meaning; differences in punctuation, capitalization, pauses and number spelling do not change the message. No removed negation, altered urgency, medication instruction or actual-delivery promise was identified.
